units.source_text: 我奉茶回来，满心期待得到母亲的夸奖，

en.t: I returned after serving the tea, full of hope that Mother would praise me.

units.source_text: 可能这么说有点夸张，不过的确是有这种期待的。

en.t: That may be putting it a little too strongly, but I really did have that expectation.

units.source_text: 可能说因为看到了母亲的泪水，我有些悲伤，或者说不知所措更为准确。

en.t: Perhaps it would be more accurate to say that seeing Mother's tears made me feel sad, or rather left me at a loss.

units.source_text: 为了躲开母亲的泪水，我坐在了哥哥身边。

en.t: To escape Mother's tears, I sat down beside my elder brother.

units.source_text: 这个时候，哥哥英吉突然抬起头来，惊讶的看了看母亲，

en.t: At that moment, my brother Eikichi suddenly raised his head and looked at Mother in surprise,

units.source_text: 又看了看我，诡异的笑了笑，然后接着读他的英文书。

en.t: then looked at me, smiled in a strange way, and went on reading his English book.

units.source_text: 我从没有像那个时候一样，痛恨我这个自称文明开化的哥哥。

en.t: Never had I hated my brother, who called himself civilized and enlightened, as much as I did then.

units.source_text: 他心里瞧不起母亲，我心里这么想着。

en.t: He looks down on Mother in his heart, I thought to myself.

units.source_text: 我猛然用力锤向哥哥的背部。

en.t: I suddenly struck my brother hard on the back.
